projects.name: Deployment gating bot
projects.summary: A GitHub App that pauses merges or deployments across 60+ GitOps repos with one switch per repo.
story: Release managers needed a way to freeze merges to main before a release, or stop dev deployments during an incident. Before this, that meant editing workflows or branch protection in every repo. This GitHub App gives them one switch per repo for two gates, merges to main and dev deployments, across 60+ GitOps-deployed repos.
How it works:
- Written in TypeScript on Probot. It hooks into GitHub deployment protection rules and the Checks API.
- Gate state lives in repo custom properties, so there's no database. The bot is stateless, so restarts
and rollbacks lose nothing.
- It fails open. If the bot is down, teams can still ship.
- Runs on Kubernetes from a Helm chart deployed by Argo CD.

I designed and built it end to end during my co-op at MasterControl: the gates, a token-authenticated control API, a 15-test Vitest suite, and a CI pipeline that publishes cosign-signed images. I also wrote the design for extending it to staging and release branches. It's an internal tool, so the code isn't public.

projects.name: AI migration agent framework
projects.summary: LangGraph and Claude Code agents that migrated about 55 Java services and got 100+ PRs merged.
story: The platform team wanted about 55 Java/Gradle services on their standard Gradle plugins (base Java setup, static analysis, and Sonar). By hand that meant a lot of near-identical PRs, so I built agents to do it.
- LangGraph runs a fixed, auditable workflow for each repo: clone it, check whether it needs the update,
make the change, open a draft PR, wait for CI, retry with the CI feedback, and post to Slack.
- Claude Code makes the actual edits inside each repo.
- I wrote the prompts (a manager agent plus subagents, 17 to 50 KB each) and revised them about 20
times, turning each repo that failed into a new rule.
- I also wrote scripts to promote passing PRs and track rollout status for the handoff.

Over three rollouts it made 100 to 150 repo changes and got over 100 PRs merged, from about 350 agent sessions in 63 repos. People only reviewed PRs that were already green. It's internal to MasterControl, so the code isn't public.
